purpose: List prices read from each vendor's own pricing page, for computing what 1,000 / 10,000 / 50,000 / 100,000 pages cost per month. Price only: anti-bot success rate, latency and output quality are NOT priced here and no claim is made about them.
basis: one page fetched and returned as Markdown on the vendor's cheapest plan that COVERS the volume; where a format or a render costs more credits per page, that multiplier is used instead of the headline rate; the monthly-billed price is used unless noted

firecrawl.quote: On Scrape and Crawl, the JSON, Question, and Highlight formats add 4 credits per page
notes: Markdown/HTML scrape or crawl page = 1 credit
JSON, Question and Highlight formats add 4 credits per page = 5 credits
JS rendering is 5 credits per successful request
premium proxies are 10 or 25 credits depending on JS rendering
hosted plan; the library itself is Apache-2.0 and free to self-host
1 credit = $0.001 at the published base rate
page 0.5 credit, real browser 1, hard site 2
crawl = map (0.1 credit per page) + extract (0.2 credit per page) = 0.3 credit per page
credits reset on the 1st of the calendar month

jina_reader.billing_unit: output tokens, counted from the response
notes: keyless: prepend https://r.jina.ai/ to a URL, rate-limited
a key raises the limit and bills tokens on content length
